title: Emrys and the Oath
author: Mirabel Reyes
blurb: Kestrel Ishikawa, a thief who steals memories, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the long winter finishes falling.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
